caseName: Innovention Toys, LLC v. Mga Entm't, Inc.
caseNameFull: INNOVENTION TOYS, LLC v. MGA ENTERTAINMENT, INC.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit. Petition for writ of certiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and *2484case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit for further consideration in light of Halo Electronics, Inc. v. Pulse Eletronics, Inc., 579 U.S. ----, 136 S.Ct. 1923, --- L.E.2d ---- (2016).
